fields.name: game work memory
fields.meaning: Everything below 5FD7 is the game's live working memory (the game runs out of the save chip); it is not the save
fields.evidence: code: live variables at 0934-4514 used by every routine; every play step changes it

fields.name: stack top
fields.meaning: Not save data: written on every power-on even with blank memory and never read back first; the top of the game stack
fields.evidence: diff of blank vs booted memory (written at first boot); boot reads touch nothing here

fields.name: copy 1 start marker
fields.meaning: Start marker of the first save copy, always 02; a copy without it is treated as empty
fields.evidence: code d000:5368 writes, d000:5474 checks; appears on save

fields.name: copy 1 length
fields.meaning: Length of the saved data block that follows (always 0B1F = 2847 bytes)
fields.evidence: code d000:5513 passes 0xB1F to the copy writer d000:5327; recomputed

fields.name: game tag
fields.meaning: Fixed game tag 'ﾓﾝﾓﾝﾃﾞｼﾞﾓﾝ V002' (half-width katakana + ASCII + zero byte) copied from game data; loading rejects a copy whose tag does not match
fields.evidence: code d000:5513 copies 16 bytes from ROM c250:0004, d000:5741 compares 16 bytes

fields.name: resume mode
fields.meaning: How Continue resumes: 0 after a normal save at the terminal, 1 on the resume-setup path, 2 on the special-save path
fields.evidence: code d000:7bc3 (=0, terminal), f000:e749 (=1), d000:a3e5 (=2); tested by title d000:5e3c and battle code

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Money, 0 to 99999999; 0 in observed saves
fields.evidence: code f000:afdf and d000:c526 add/subtract it with a clamp to 99999999 (0x5F5E0FF); read by number-display code; new game sets 0

fields.name: battle points
fields.meaning: Battle score, capped at 10000; 11 in the natural save
fields.evidence: code e000:c3d9 (+1 per scoring hit, +3 per KO, cap 0x2710), resets in d000:8d6c/e000:1d9a/f000:d609

fields.name: Digimon list
fields.meaning: 30 Digimon records of 0x48 bytes each; only the first is used in observed saves; per-record rows below are record offsets in hex
fields.evidence: code d000:5513 copies 0x870 bytes from the live list at 0aca; new game clears all 30

fields.name: record: in use
fields.meaning: 1 = this record holds a Digimon, 0 = empty
fields.evidence: code d000:f30f tests ==1, d000:ea23/ef5c set/clear; record 0 = 1, rest 0

fields.name: record: species
fields.meaning: Species number (2 in observed saves); the matching species-table entry is 2 = owned
fields.evidence: code d000:f30f writes species_table[species]=2; first Digimon created as species 2 (d000:ea25)

fields.name: record: creation block
fields.meaning: Fixed 16-byte block copied from game data when a Digimon is created (base stats or default moves; exact split open)
fields.evidence: code d000:ea2e copies 16 bytes from ROM cacf:0000 (via table cad2:0002/0004); bytes match the ROM exactly

fields.name: record: data A
fields.meaning: Unknown 18 bytes of per-Digimon data
fields.evidence: written at creation by f000:ccdd (offsets not mapped); single species observed

fields.name: record: step counters
fields.meaning: Two identical step counters; the only save bytes that changed between two saves of one game (1 -> 5) besides the checksum
fields.evidence: diff of two natural saves of the same game; both rise while walking and are always equal

fields.name: record: data B
fields.meaning: Unknown 34 bytes of per-Digimon data
fields.evidence: dump only; single species observed

fields.name: sorted id list
fields.meaning: 32-slot id list kept sorted ascending, 0xFF past the count; browsed as a menu; seeded with 2, story adds 0 and 1 (entry meaning open)
fields.evidence: code d000:ecc4 appends, d000:ebc2 sorts + fills FF, f000:a998 browses; writers f000:d6ae/d000:8d62/8df3/f000:e936

fields.name: id-list count
fields.meaning: Entries used in the sorted id list (max 32); 1 in observed saves
fields.evidence: code d000:ecc4/ec58 raise/lower it with a 32 cap; menu bound in f000:a998

fields.name: Digimon count
fields.meaning: Number of used records in the Digimon list, max 30; 1 in observed saves
fields.evidence: code: ++ on join (story d000:8e48 etc, gift d000:59ee, join f000:3fe4), -- on release d000:ef9c, 0 at new game; refused at 30 (f000:3f28)

fields.name: battle-party picks
fields.meaning: Three current battle-party picks (Digimon indexes, FF = empty); FF FF FF when none chosen
fields.evidence: code f000:4db1 'pick 3' logic compares with the locked copy and counts picks; f000:4fd2 locks them in; new game sets FF

fields.name: picks made
fields.meaning: Battle-party picks made so far, 0 to 3; 0 when none chosen
fields.evidence: code f000:4db1: ==3 advances, else resets to 0 with the picks

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown byte (0)
fields.evidence: new game sets 0; no other code references found

fields.name: event triggers
fields.meaning: 18 event trigger bytes; 1 runs the matching story event; first is 1 in observed saves
fields.evidence: code story/field routines test ==1 (d000:8d27/8a54/705c); new game clears all then sets slot 0

fields.name: Digimon capacity
fields.meaning: How many Digimon the player may hold; 8 at new game, story and shop raise it by 2, 3 or 5
fields.evidence: code f000:d6ea (=8), d000:8e9b/8f74 (+2), d000:909c (+3), d000:caa6 (+5); gift checks count against it

fields.name: species table
fields.meaning: One byte per species (113): 2 = owned, 1 = seen, 0 = unmet
fields.evidence: code d000:f30f writes 2 for owned (owned species 2 matches); 1 seen at species 0 and 20 (writer not found)

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown 73 bytes (all zero)
fields.evidence: packed by the save code; no direct code references found

fields.name: per-species table
fields.meaning: Unknown 113 bytes, one per species like the species table (all zero)
fields.evidence: packed by the save code; same length as the species table; no direct references

fields.name: battle-party slots
fields.meaning: Three 72-byte battle-party slots (flag byte each at stride 0x48); all zero outside battle
fields.evidence: code new game (f000:d5f5) and battle end (d000:62f6) clear the flags, join path (f000:3f3b) tests them; zero in all play states; saved but never reloaded (d000:5741 skips it)

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown 11 bytes (zero)
fields.evidence: packed by the save code; no direct code references found

fields.name: map number
fields.meaning: Map the player is on (4 = the terminal platform area; 0 at new game; field code handles 0 to 10+)
fields.evidence: code map transitions (d000:7f7a..), story sets (d000:8dad etc), new game 0; walked 4 -> 1 across a map edge

fields.name: player X
fields.meaning: Player X pixel position (0x58 at the terminal)
fields.evidence: code d000:8651/865d step +1/-1, grid snap on resume d000:6d5a; 4 left steps moved 0x58 -> 0x38 (8 px/step)

fields.name: player Y
fields.meaning: Player Y pixel position (0x48 at the terminal)
fields.evidence: code d000:864b/8657 step -1/+1, grid snap on resume d000:6d66; down steps increase it

fields.name: event table
fields.meaning: 18 per-trigger event ids; identity 0..17 at new game, story setup overwrites slots with 0x10..0x1c
fields.evidence: code d000:8a54 writes 12 slots from triggers on field resume; new game writes identity

fields.name: story flag
fields.meaning: Story flag: 0 at new game, set to 1 by story events
fields.evidence: code d000:93fe/942f set 1, d000:90d4 tests 0, new game sets 0

fields.name: events done
fields.meaning: 12 flags, set to 1 once each story event has played
fields.evidence: code d000:8d27 tests ==0 then sets 1 for all 12

fields.name: event flag
fields.meaning: Event flag 0/1, consumed by story setup
fields.evidence: code d000:aee4 sets 1, d000:8a54/8aea test it, new game sets 0

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Unknown 20 bytes (5F E3 3A then FF and 00 fill); written during the intro
fields.evidence: packed by the save code; no direct code references found

fields.name: shop level
fields.meaning: Shop upgrade count, 0 to 3
fields.evidence: code d000:c526 caps at 3, charges money and +5 capacity per purchase (d000:ca9a/caa2/caa6)

fields.name: story id
fields.meaning: Story progress id: 0x1E at new game, 0x1F/0x20 set by story events
fields.evidence: code f000:d6b3 (=1E), d000:8d67 (=1F), d000:8df8 (=20); read by shop and resume code

fields.name: stage cursor
fields.meaning: Stage cursor 0..17; also selects the trigger slot on resume
fields.evidence: code wraps 0..17 on pad input (e000:a665), set 1..17 in field (d000:705c), indexes triggers (f000:e729)

fields.name: sub cursor
fields.meaning: Sub-menu cursor 0..N-1; part of the resume context
fields.evidence: code wraps on pad input (e000:a665), bumped around one save path (f000:f620), branches resume (d000:5e3c/f000:e729)

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Three unknown 16-bit values (zero)
fields.evidence: only the save pack/unpack touch them

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Three unknown 16-bit values (zero)
fields.evidence: only the save pack/unpack touch them

fields.name: locked party picks
fields.meaning: Locked copy of the battle-party picks (FF = empty)
fields.evidence: code f000:4fd2 copies the current picks here on confirm; f000:4db1 requires lock == picks

fields.name: play counter
fields.meaning: 32-bit counter, advanced while trigger 13 is set (always 0 in saves)
fields.evidence: code d000:9964 increments below 70010 and raises a live flag past 70000; new game sets 0

fields.name: copy 1 end marker
fields.meaning: End marker, always 03
fields.evidence: code d000:5327 writes it after the data, d000:5474 checks it

fields.name: copy 1 checksum
fields.meaning: CRC-16/KERMIT (start 0) over the length field, data and end marker, stored low byte first
fields.evidence: recomputed over every archived save image (144 valid copies, all match); code d000:0580 with tables d000:05c0/06c0

fields.name: padding
fields.meaning: Unused gap between the two copies (zero)
fields.evidence: copies are 0xB29 apart (d000:5346), the framed block is 0xB25 long

fields.name: copy 2 (backup)
fields.meaning: Second identical copy with the same layout, written right after the first on every save; read only when the first copy is missing, damaged or has the wrong tag
fields.evidence: code d000:5513 writes copies 0 and 1; d000:5741 tries copy 0 then copy 1; both copies identical in saves

fields.name: gap after save
fields.meaning: Unused by the save (zero)
fields.evidence: all zero in every save image

fields.name: gift tag check
fields.meaning: 16 bytes compared against the game tag when loading; on a match (and room) one gift Digimon is added, the game re-saves, and the box is cleared (likely a link-cable gift)
fields.evidence: code d000:5994-59f2 (compare, append record, count++, save, clear); zeros in all saves

fields.name: gift record
fields.meaning: 72-byte Digimon record copied into the list when the gift tag matches
fields.evidence: code d000:59ca copies 0x48 bytes from 7810 to list[count]

fields.name: not used by this save
fields.meaning: The console's internal memory is not changed by saving
fields.evidence: identical before and after every save
